{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string with commas to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the data types and missing values
print(sales_df.dtypes)
print('\nMissing values:\n', sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age: -1 means not supplied
print('\nUnique values in customer_age:', sales_df['customer_age'].unique())

# Check the distribution of converted
print('\nConverted status distribution:\n', sales_df['converted'].value_counts())

# Filter for customers who converted and have valid age (not -1)
converted_customers = sales_df[(sales_df['converted'] == 1) & (sales_df['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'\nMean age of customers who converted: {mean_age_converted:.2f} years')"}
